description.en-US: Connect documents, messages, calendars, and tables.
description.zh-CN: 连接文档、消息、日历与多维表格。

setup.en-US: Install the managed integration and connect your account.
setup.zh-CN: 安装集成并连接自己的账号。

description.en-US: Send text or Markdown notifications to a Feishu group through its custom bot.
description.zh-CN: 通过自定义机器人向飞书群发送文本或 Markdown 通知。

setup.en-US: In the Feishu group, add a Custom Bot, enable Signature Verification, then enter the token at the end of its webhook address (after /hook/) and the signing secret. Saving sends no message; this plugin does not read chats.
setup.zh-CN: 在飞书群「设置 → 群机器人」添加自定义机器人并开启「签名校验」，填写 Webhook 地址末尾（/hook/ 之后）的令牌和签名密钥。保存不会发送消息；此插件不读取聊天。

description.en-US: Send text and Markdown notifications to a configured DingTalk group robot.
description.zh-CN: 向配置的钉钉群机器人发送文本或 Markdown 通知。

setup.en-US: Create a signed custom group robot. Enter its access_token and signing secret. This does not read chats, documents or calendars.
setup.zh-CN: 创建启用加签的自定义群机器人，填写 Webhook 的 access_token 和加签密钥。此插件不读取聊天、文档或日历。

description.en-US: Send text and Markdown notifications to a configured WeCom group robot.
description.zh-CN: 向配置的企业微信群机器人发送文本或 Markdown 通知。

setup.en-US: Create a group robot and copy the key parameter from its webhook URL. This does not connect the incoming chat channel or access documents.
setup.zh-CN: 创建群机器人，复制 Webhook 地址中的 key 参数。此插件用于主动通知，不接入收消息通道或读取文档。

description.en-US: Find and update shared documents and spreadsheets.
description.zh-CN: 查找与更新在线文档、表格，协同整理团队资料。

setup.en-US: Follow the provider's setup guide, prepare the required account or API credentials, then add its MCP server using Add MCP plugin. Adding a configuration does not verify the connection.
setup.zh-CN: 按提供方文档准备账号或 API 凭据，再通过「添加 MCP 插件」录入服务配置。保存配置后仍需验证连接和权限。

description.en-US: Read Feishu docs and wiki pages from their links.
description.zh-CN: 粘贴飞书文档或知识库链接，读取正文内容。

setup.en-US: Create a custom app on open.feishu.cn, grant docx:document:readonly and wiki:wiki:readonly, publish it, and enter its App ID and App Secret. The app only reads documents it can access: add it from a document's ... > Add Document App, or add it to the wiki space.
setup.zh-CN: 在飞书开放平台创建企业自建应用，开通 docx:document:readonly 和 wiki:wiki:readonly 权限并发布版本，填写 App ID 与 App Secret。应用只能读有权限的文档：在文档右上角「… → 添加文档应用」加入该应用，或把应用加入知识库成员。

description.en-US: Read Google Docs shared as "Anyone with the link".
description.zh-CN: 读取共享设置为「知道链接的任何人」的 Google 文档。

setup.en-US: No account is needed. Share the document as "Anyone with the link can view", then paste its link in a conversation. Private documents are not supported yet.
setup.zh-CN: 无需账号。把文档共享设置改为「知道链接的任何人均可查看」，在对话中粘贴链接即可读取。暂不支持私有文档。

description.en-US: Search your team's wiki, notes, and project knowledge.
description.zh-CN: 搜索团队知识库、笔记与项目文档，沉淀工作信息。

setup.en-US: Follow the provider's setup guide, prepare the required account or API credentials, then add its MCP server using Add MCP plugin. Adding a configuration does not verify the connection.
setup.zh-CN: 按提供方文档准备账号或 API 凭据，再通过「添加 MCP 插件」录入服务配置。保存配置后仍需验证连接和权限。

description.en-US: Organize long-term memory and reusable agent resources.
description.zh-CN: 统一管理长期记忆与资源，为 Agent 提供工作上下文。

setup.en-US: Deploy the provider's MCP server yourself, then enter its HTTP(S) address and, if the server requires one, the full Authorization header (for example Bearer <token>). GGWork tests the connection after saving.
setup.zh-CN: 先按提供方文档自行部署其 MCP 服务，再填写服务的 HTTP(S) 地址；服务要求鉴权时填写完整的 Authorization 请求头（例如 Bearer <token>）。保存后会自动测试连接。

description.en-US: Search the web with your configured search provider.
description.zh-CN: 搜索公开网页，为研究和决策补充信息来源。

setup.en-US: Built into this deployment and needs no account. The agent uses it when a question needs public web information.
setup.zh-CN: 当前部署已内置，无需账号。问题需要公开网页信息时，Agent 会自动使用。

description.en-US: Read web pages and extract useful content with Jina.
description.zh-CN: 读取网页正文，提取资料，供 Agent 进一步分析。

setup.en-US: Built into this deployment and needs no account. The agent uses it when a question needs public web information.
setup.zh-CN: 当前部署已内置，无需账号。问题需要公开网页信息时，Agent 会自动使用。

description.en-US: Find relevant sources with semantic web search.
description.zh-CN: 通过语义搜索找到相关网页，开展行业与公司研究。

setup.en-US: Enter an Exa API key from dashboard.exa.ai. Each search uses your Exa quota.
setup.zh-CN: 填写在 dashboard.exa.ai 创建的 API Key。每次搜索消耗该账号的 Exa 额度。

description.en-US: Read a web page's main content as Markdown for analysis.
description.zh-CN: 抓取网页正文，转为便于分析的 Markdown 资料。

setup.en-US: Enter a Firecrawl API key from firecrawl.dev. Each page read uses your Firecrawl credits.
setup.zh-CN: 填写在 firecrawl.dev 创建的 API Key。每读取一个网页消耗该账号的 Firecrawl 额度。

description.en-US: Connect business data in PostgreSQL, MySQL, and more.
description.zh-CN: 连接 PostgreSQL、MySQL 等数据库，查询与分析业务数据。

setup.en-US: Deploy the provider's MCP server yourself, then enter its HTTP(S) address and, if the server requires one, the full Authorization header (for example Bearer <token>). GGWork tests the connection after saving.
setup.zh-CN: 先按提供方文档自行部署其 MCP 服务，再填写服务的 HTTP(S) 地址；服务要求鉴权时填写完整的 Authorization 请求头（例如 Bearer <token>）。保存后会自动测试连接。

description.en-US: Read companies and create contacts with a private app access token.
description.zh-CN: 使用私有应用令牌查询公司、创建联系人。

setup.en-US: Provide a private app access token with crm.objects.companies.read and crm.objects.contacts.write. Reading companies does not create records; contacts are created only when the tool is called.
setup.zh-CN: 填写私有应用令牌，并授予 crm.objects.companies.read 和 crm.objects.contacts.write 权限。查询公司不会创建数据；只有调用创建联系人工具时才写入。

description.en-US: Read repositories, code, issues and pull requests (read-only).
description.zh-CN: 只读查看仓库、代码、Issue 与 Pull Request。

setup.en-US: Create a personal access token on GitHub (Settings > Developer settings). Fine-grained: grant read-only Contents, Issues, Pull requests and Metadata for the repositories to expose. Classic: the repo scope, plus read:org for organization data. GGWork connects to GitHub's official remote MCP server in read-only mode.
setup.zh-CN: 在 GitHub「Settings → Developer settings」创建个人访问令牌。细粒度令牌：对要开放的仓库授予 Contents、Issues、Pull requests、Metadata 的只读权限；经典令牌：勾选 repo，需要组织信息再加 read:org。GGWork 以只读模式连接 GitHub 官方远程 MCP 服务。

description.en-US: Connect project issues, team pages, and delivery plans.
description.zh-CN: 连接项目需求、团队文档与交付计划，追踪研发进展。

setup.en-US: An Atlassian organization admin must first allow API token authentication for the Rovo MCP server (Atlassian Administration > Rovo settings). Then create a scoped API token with read:jira-work, read:page:confluence, search:confluence and search:rovo:mcp, and enter it with the account email. Writes depend on the token's scopes.
setup.zh-CN: 先由 Atlassian 组织管理员在「Atlassian Administration → Rovo 设置」开启 Rovo MCP 服务的 API 令牌认证；再创建带作用域的 API 令牌，授予 read:jira-work、read:page:confluence、search:confluence、search:rovo:mcp，连同账号邮箱一起填写。能否写入取决于令牌作用域。

description.en-US: Open pages and complete browser tasks with Playwright.
description.zh-CN: 基于 Playwright 打开网页、提取内容与执行页面操作。

setup.en-US: This capability is supported by GGWork. Ask your administrator to select a provider and configure its credentials in config.yaml. Availability depends on this deployment; this directory does not check its runtime status.
setup.zh-CN: GGWork 已支持此能力。请由管理员在 config.yaml 中选择服务并配置所需凭据；能否使用取决于当前部署，本目录尚未检测运行状态。
